exposure: gestational age at planned cesarean delivery
Planned cesarean delivery at 39 weeks gestation
Planned cesarean delivery at 38 weeks gestation
cohort: 656 women with at least 2 previous cesarean deliveries
finding: Planned cesarean delivery at 39 weeks gestation, compared to 38 weeks, was associated with more unscheduled cesarean deliveries, similar rates of maternal and neonatal composite morbidity, but a decreased rate of neonatal respiratory morbidity.
mod_finding: Compared with planned cesarean delivery, unscheduled cesarean delivery was associated with a similar rate of maternal composite adverse outcome, but with an increased rate of neonatal composite adverse outcome, largely due to earlier gestational age at delivery.
